text: Twenty videos ago, Harborview had a shared login and no real access control. This is the honest ending -- not a highlight reel -- of what actually changed.

What got built is real: Auto Loader through a Lakeflow pipeline into a governed gold layer, clinic row filters and identifier masks enforced on the table itself, orchestrated nightly, surfaced in one summary-only report.
What's still open, named plainly: expectation violations mostly wait on a weekly dashboard, the clinic lookup table needs a human to stay current, and schema evolution has no governance gate.
This solved the real governance problem, and fixed a real bug along the way. It didn't solve alerting, staffing-change automation, or new-column review -- those are named, not hidden.
Harborview's claims data is governed clinic by clinic, built and tested in the open, bugs and all. That's the series.
